visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male character wearing a pale green t-shirt, a dark grey baseball cap with '2/2' text, and glasses stands in front of a red and black wall featuring a large white 'Pizza Hut' logo. He is holding the straps of a black backpack over his shoulders. He speaks directly to the camera with an expressive and smiling facial expression, then proceeds to sit down on a red cushioned booth seat, moving his body downwards until he is partially out of frame. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a modern restaurant interior. (2) The scene transitions to a close-up overhead view of a refrigerated salad bar buffet area. Three black rectangular plastic trays are prominently displayed: the leftmost tray is filled with neatly sliced orange segments, the middle tray contains sliced green-skinned pomelo or grapefruit pieces, and the right tray holds shredded green lettuce. A colorful illustrative sign is visible at the top of the frame, showing images of various salad ingredients and text in Chinese. The background is a clean, metallic food service counter. (3) The final visual phase shows a row of freshly prepared pizzas on a buffet serving line. The primary pizza in the foreground is cut into slices and features a thick, golden-brown crust topped with melted cheese, pieces of ham or meat, pineapple chunks, and a dark brown sauce drizzle. Behind it, several other pizzas of different varieties are placed on circular metal stands, suggesting a wide selection. The environment is well-lit with warm-toned overhead lights reflecting off the metal surfaces.
